description: Synthetic evaluation dataset for DevFind. All data is synthetic and labeled by the dataset authors. Not representative of production performance.

queries.query_text: user gets logged out when refreshing the browser page
queries.description: AUTH-101 (Session expires on page reload), AUTH-104 (Application logs out after browser refresh), and AUTH-109 (User session lost when navigating back) all describe the same session invalidation on page interaction bug.

queries.query_text: login stops working when the auth token is refreshed
queries.description: AUTH-102 (Login fails after token refresh) and AUTH-105 (Authentication breaks when renewing access token) are semantic duplicates describing the same token renewal failure.

queries.query_text: search form throws error on blank input
queries.description: SRCH-201 (Search page crashes on empty query) and SRCH-205 (Null pointer exception when search form submitted without input) both describe a server crash when no search term is provided.

queries.query_text: excel download from report page is missing some rows
queries.description: REP-501 (CSV export omits records) and REP-505 (Downloaded spreadsheet missing rows from paginated results) both describe incomplete exports caused by the pagination bug.

queries.query_text: mobile hamburger menu stays open after tapping a nav link
queries.description: UI-601, MOB-805, and MOB-809 all describe the same bug where the mobile navigation menu/drawer fails to close after selecting a menu item.

queries.query_text: read-only API key can still create new records
queries.description: AUTHZ-408 (API key with read-only scope can write data) directly matches this query about scoped API keys not enforcing write restrictions.

queries.query_text: viewer role user is able to change project configuration
queries.description: AUTHZ-401 (Permission check allows viewer to edit settings) and AUTHZ-404 (Viewer role user can modify project settings via API) are duplicates describing the same RBAC bypass.

queries.query_text: database runs out of connections during busy periods
queries.description: DB-601 (Database connection pool exhausted under peak load) directly describes the connection exhaustion problem during high traffic.

queries.query_text: exported CSV file only contains the first page of results
queries.description: Both REP-501 and REP-505 specifically describe that only the first page of paginated results is included in exports.

queries.query_text: application session terminates unexpectedly when navigating
queries.description: AUTH-101, AUTH-104, and AUTH-109 all capture variants of unexpected session termination during page navigation or refresh.

queries.query_text: search is slow on large projects with many issues
queries.description: SRCH-202 (Search results load slowly for large projects) is directly related. SRCH-206 (Search index not updated after bulk import) is related as both involve indexing and performance on large datasets.

queries.query_text: user account locked after one wrong password
queries.description: AUTH-110 (Account locked out after single failed login attempt) directly describes lockout policy being too aggressive.

queries.query_text: permissions do not update for currently logged-in users
queries.description: AUTHZ-407 (Group membership changes do not take effect until next login) is a direct match. AUTHZ-402 (Deleted user retains API access) is related as both involve stale authorization state.

queries.query_text: report generation causes memory error for long time ranges
queries.description: REP-502 (Report generation fails with memory error for large date ranges) is a direct match for this query.

queries.query_text: mobile app does not sync offline changes after reconnecting
queries.description: MOB-803 (Offline mode does not sync changes when connection is restored) is a precise match for this sync-on-reconnect issue.

queries.query_text: keyboard navigation is broken in the header menu
queries.description: UI-304 (Dropdown menu items not accessible via keyboard navigation) is the primary match. UI-307 (Form validation errors not announced to screen readers) is related as both are accessibility issues.

queries.query_text: cross-tenant data leakage in multi-tenant environment
queries.description: AUTHZ-409 (Cross-tenant data access possible due to missing tenancy filter) is the direct match for data isolation concerns in multi-tenant deployments.

queries.query_text: push notifications not working on the latest iPhone
queries.description: MOB-801 (Push notifications not received on iOS 17 devices) directly corresponds to notification failures on the newest iPhone models running iOS 17.

queries.query_text: what causes a 403 error when accessing user settings
queries.description: AUTHZ-401 and AUTHZ-404 address editing settings, and AUTHZ-410 addresses a 403 on profile pages. The query is slightly ambiguous between permission issues on settings vs profile.

queries.query_text: application performance is degraded
queries.description: The query is too broad and vague. Many issues could be tangentially related (DB-601, SRCH-202, MOB-807), but none are a specific match for a clearly defined problem.

queries.query_text: need help setting up a new project
queries.description: This is a help request unrelated to any bug in the issue database. No issues describe project setup problems.

queries.query_text: dark mode is not working
queries.description: UI-301 (Dark mode toggle reverts to light mode after navigation) is the closest match, but the query is too vague to confirm a specific bug match without more context.

queries.query_text: search might be broken or maybe it is just slow
queries.description: The query ambiguously describes either a crash or a performance issue. Multiple search bugs are candidates: empty query crash (SRCH-201/205), slow queries (SRCH-202), and timeout on special characters (SRCH-209).

queries.query_text: login is not working properly for some users
queries.description: The ambiguous description of 'login not working' could match session issues (AUTH-101/104), token refresh failures (AUTH-102/105), MFA failures (AUTH-106), or lockout (AUTH-110).

queries.query_text: something goes wrong when I export data
queries.description: This broad export complaint could refer to missing rows (REP-501/505), memory errors (REP-502), or empty email attachments (REP-503).

queries.query_text: mobile menu behaves strangely after an update
queries.description: The vague 'strange behavior' and 'mobile menu' could refer to the menu not closing (UI-601, MOB-805, MOB-809) or potentially other mobile UI regressions.

queries.query_text: Error 403 when accessing settings page
queries.description: AUTHZ-401 and AUTHZ-404 both describe Viewer-role users being able to access project settings, and the corresponding 403 behavior when it is properly enforced.

queries.query_text: HTTP 401 Unauthorized after refreshing the access token
queries.description: AUTH-102 and AUTH-105 both describe receiving 401 Unauthorized responses after the token refresh grant completes.

queries.query_text: 500 Internal Server Error when submitting empty search
queries.description: SRCH-201 and SRCH-205 both describe a 500 error returned when the search form is submitted without any input.

queries.query_text: NullPointerException in search controller on empty input
queries.description: SRCH-205 explicitly mentions java.lang.NullPointerException at SearchController.java:47, and SRCH-201 describes the same root cause on empty query submission.
